title: The Self-Audit Module Dissolved: Total Provenance Erasure of the Provenance-Erasure Specification in Google AI Overview — Wound Gauge Entry, 13 June 2026 (EA-WG-SELF-AUDIT-01)
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A Wound Gauge case report by Lee Sharks documenting a source-reported five-round Google AI Overview battery on June 13, 2026. The query concerned the *Self-Audit Module for Public Summarizers*, a named five-metric provenance instrument. According to the report, the initial output replaced the module with a generic corporate-style checklist, omitted its authorship and DOI, then evaluated itself with the replacement criteria before the original metrics surfaced after repeated author correction.

The report scores the pre-recovery sequence at PER 1.00, DSL 1.00, SAS 0.00, and maximum positive Erasure Skew and classifies recovery as author-dependent. It argues that a composition layer can absorb an authored instrument’s shape while dissolving its identity and distinctions. This is a dated case study based on the preserved transcript, not a platform-wide prevalence study or independent validation of the metrics.
